prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sync Flow: Move sign-in to take place after pet pick and adoption certificate creation so users fall in love with their pet before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [finish, redesign] Interactive Pet Controls Playground: Redesign home_intro into an interactive stage layout where users test dragging, hiding, and talking to their desktop pet directly.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Try out your pet's controls!", "body": "Practice dragging, hiding, and speaking with your pet right on your screen before completing setup.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_interactive", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Practice Desktop Commands"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Quality Diagnostic Screen: Add a new photo check screen to inspect image quality, crop, and framing before generating custom pets.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_check", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"hint": "Ensure your photo is well-lit for accurate pet generation."}}
3: [home, new_flow] Background Pet Loader Flow: Transform the waiting step into a split background loader screen showing active desktop permission checks and pet spawning progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Spawning your pet onto the desktop...", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Checking desktop overlay permissions...", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
4: [choose_path, hint] Quick Start Path Selection Hint: Add a helper badge and path duration hint on choose_path to steer undecided users toward preset adoption.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Preset pets ready in 30s. Custom pets take 2 minutes.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Fastest Setup: Choose Preset Pet", "style": "highlight"}]}}
5: [adoption, layout] Split Pet Selection Stage: Change pick_friend screen layout to split view and add audio previews of pet sounds and voice.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your New Companion", "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Listen to Pet Sounds", "action": "play"}]}}
6: [sign_in, incentive] Account Recovery Warning Banner: Add an explicit data-protection badge and copy explaining that signing in saves your pet permanently.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet to the Cloud", "body": "Sign in now to prevent your pet's stats, level, and memories from being reset.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Prevents Pet Reset & Data Loss", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Permissions Alert Indicator: Enable ready notifications and add a desktop visibility troubleshooting action button during waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "If your pet does not appear on your desktop, verify app draw permissions.", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Check Display Permissions", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
8: [finish, hint] Desktop Command Cheat Sheet Summary: Include shortcut hint copy and step counter display on home_intro to reinforce main controls before exiting onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Press Alt+P anytime to hide or summon your pet on your desktop.", "show_step_counter": true}}
9: [choose_path, redesign] Story Mode Onboarding Hub Redesign: Redesign story screen into a interactive video carousel to showcase pet interactions before selecting a path.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "video", "asset": "asset:intro_preview", "style": "rounded"}]}, "choose_path": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Journey"}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in to take place after adoption certificate creation is explicitly permitted under Rule 4.
Redesigning the home intro into an interactive playground is allowed as it remains within onboarding.
Adding a custom photo check diagnostic screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen to show spawning progress and overlay permissions retains its required job.
Adding setup duration hints and helper badges on choose_path preserves both options and does not violate design rules.
Adding audio previews to the friend selection screen preserves its core function while improving interactive design.
Using threats of pet resets and data loss to pressure users into signing in violates Rule 5 against coercive dark patterns and false urgency.
Adding ready notifications and display permission troubleshooting buttons during waiting is permitted.
Adding keyboard shortcut hints and step counter indicators on home_intro is allowed.
Redesigning story into a video carousel and choose_path into a card layout retains the required jobs of both screens.
